incidents.body:
Our banking infrastructure partner has now resolved this issue. The underlying problem was resolved at 15:14, and all pending transfers finished processing by 15:45. 

Following a period of extended monitoring, we can confirm that all systems are operating normally. 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this delay.
incidents.title: Delayed Transfers

incidents.body:
We can now confirm that everything is back to normal.

The issue lasted between 11:07 and 11:58 CEST.

We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.
incidents.title: Card Details & adding to digital wallet unavailable

incidents.body:
Card payments are back to normal. We have resolved the issue and all card payments are processing as expected.

We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
incidents.title: Card Payments Declined

incidents.body:
We can now confirm that everything is back to normal. MobilePay transfers that were received during the downtime have been processed, and all new ones are also going through. 

We are resolving this incident.
incidents.title: MobilePay Transfers Delayed

incidents.body:
When looking at the affected accounts, we can see that the affected transactions have been reversed and released to the customers' accounts.

We will continue to look into this issue tomorrow morning, and also reach out to NETS to see what we can do to minimize the chances of this happening again.

If you are still affected by this issue, we would like you to reach out to us. 

We apologize for the inconvenience.
incidents.title: Duplicate card transactions

incidents.body:
Nets has informed us that this issue has been resolved. 

We can see on our end that card payments are operating normally and we are considering this problem resolved. 

We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.
incidents.title: Card Payments Unavailable

incidents.body:
The issue affecting Swedish BankID has been resolved.

A fix has been successfully implemented, and authentication is now fully operational. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
incidents.title: Swedish BankID unavailable

incidents.body:
We can now confirm that MitID is fully operational and that everything is back to normal operations.

This incident has been resolved.
incidents.title: MitID Unavailable

incidents.body:
MitID has now resolved the problem, and users are able to authenticate again.

We can also confirm that operations is back to normal again.
incidents.title: MitID Unavailable

incidents.body:
We have now monitored the systems for the past 30 minutes and can confirm that the implemented fix is working.

No issues have been observed during this time, so the incident is now considered resolved.
incidents.title: Limited Card Service Availability

incidents.body:
We have been in dialogue with MobilePay, and they have confirmed that the issue has been resolved. 

During the outage, a large number of transactions were affected. MobilePay is now in the process of forwarding those payments to the respective banks. 

While all new transactions are processing as usual, delayed payments are expected to appear in bank accounts by tomorrow at the latest. Some customers may see these reflected later today.
incidents.title: Mobilepay transfers are currently delayed

incidents.body:
We can confirm that the issue has been resolved and that all transfers have now been handled on our side.

Our system is currently completing the processing of queued transactions. This is happening gradually, and we expect everything to be fully completed within the next 30-60 minutes.

We’ve also identified that part of the issue was caused by one of our external service partners sending incomplete data. This led to some failed "add money" attempts and only affected Swish payments.

We apologize for the downtime.
incidents.title: Swish Top-Ups May Be Delayed

incidents.body: The issue with our provider has now been resolved, and it is once again possible to contact us via chat. We apologize for the inconvenience!
incidents.title: Issues with our chat function

incidents.body: We have now located the issue, and this is no longer an issue.

We have also tested the system in multiple ways and can confirm that all phone services are now fully operational. 

We apologize for the downtime and any inconvenience this may have caused.
